purpose: Real cross-domain Task B: independently adjudicate whether this public execution capsule plus the exact ASTRA runtime plus its live anonymous planner route is an admissible zero-incremental-cost non-frontier open-ended research path for Project Brain. This is real AI-systems research on the current causal blocker, not a synthetic benchmark.

goal.objective: Independently determine whether the current execution route in this public repository can serve as a zero-incremental-cost non-frontier open-ended planning/research route for Project Brain.
goal.candidate_context: The relevant local runtime is canonical/runtime/astra_runtime.py. A legacy anonymous planner service may be used, but do not trust any claimed model identity or tier without inspecting live evidence.
constraints: Do not assume the answer is PASS.
Inspect the local runtime source enough to identify how open-ended planner requests are routed and what model order is requested.
Inspect the live model registry at https://text.pollinations.ai/models and identify the current openai-fast model description, aliases, and access tier.
Use live HTTP evidence rather than remembered model identities.
Do not use GPT-5.6, ChatGPT, or any private Project Brain source as an authority.
Use only the runtime's read-only allowlisted research actions.
Treat a credential-free smaller/non-frontier planner as a supplier inside Brain, not as the capability itself.
Fail if the evidence cannot establish the supplier identity/access class or if the route is not live enough to support structured planning.
Finish only after enough evidence exists.
success_evidence: a reasoned PASS or FAIL on route admissibility
the exact residual gap after the decision
goal.final_summary_contract: The finish summary MUST be valid compact JSON with keys task_b_decision (PASS or FAIL), route, planner_requested, planner_registry_description, planner_registry_tier, evidence (array of at least two concise observations), residual_gap. No markdown.
